title: I Printed the Laminator Quota After They Ran Visitor Badges on My Code

parts.text: I printed the laminator quota at 9:17 a.m. after they ran visitor badges on my code. The count showed a run I did not start. I was twenty-eight, analyst, standing at a laminator that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the code, the pouch still, and the remaining count. Facilities reset the quota and dated the badge. I keep the pouch still. The laminator finally knows my code from a visitor.

social.description: Quota I did not start, pouch still, remaining count. Facilities reset it. Has a visitor ever spent your code?
